decisions.statement: A default is the value a writer states when the writer is told nothing.
A page has no value the page does not state.
A default does not make a required property optional.
A default stands on the declaration rather than on the property.
One property takes a different default under each page type declaring the property.
A default is written as text whatever kind the property the default stands for holds.
A default has the kind its property has.

definition: the value a writer states for a property when it is told none
